results.justification: Same defect: idx_t returns/args typed as signed intp instead of uint64 (duckdb_column_count, duckdb_data_chunk_get_column_count/get_size, duckdb_row_count, and the col_idx/row arg). Current DCK-wrap-COR-1 and DCK-sig-COR-1 both report this exact type-signedness inconsistency against the CLAUDE.md idx_t->uint64 convention on the current @proxy tree; line numbers shifted +1 (L106 etc.) but the root cause is identical.

Same defect: duckdb_vector_get_validity return typed uint64 while the C prototype returns uint64_t* (a pointer), violating the all-pointers-are-intp convention. Current DCK-sig-COR-2 and XC-numbox-COR-1 report this directly (L237), and current DCK-wrap-COR-1 also folds it in. Present on the current tree.

Same defect: duckdb_create_varint (L728) and duckdb_get_varint (L1053) docstrings use the non-canonical version-pinned https://duckdb.org/docs/1.3/clients/c/api#... links (no .html) instead of the mandated stable api.html form. Current DCK-wrap-COR-2 and DCK-sig-DES-3 report exactly these two deviating links; line numbers shifted +1.
